claim_falsified: The DS17 linear-conditional-mean obstruction extends to the (M5)-free margin pair: on an LCM law every bounded-packet stationary K=3 configuration with positive cell masses has a rank-deficient binned information matrix, so the conditioning margin (M3) alone already empties the stationary class.
construction: The K=3 sign-split sibling of CE-DS-POP-WASTED-CELLS-001 on the same nuisance-sign-symmetric 8-atom law: the left half {s_psi < 0} split by sign(s_lambda) into cells A and B, the right half one cell C. B*_q = 0 by the sign symmetry, so the efficient projection is s_psi and the projected centroids are (-2, -2, 2): cells A and B coincide in projection while every atom satisfies the nearest-projected-centroid rule (with ties). The continuous counterpart on N(0, I_2) is {S_psi<0, S_lambda>0}, {S_psi<0, S_lambda<=0}, {S_psi>=0} with I_q = diag(2/pi, 1/pi) and profiled value exactly v_2 = 2/pi.

exact_quantities.reduced_rule_nuisance_block: 0 (merging the coincident pair gives the K=2 s_psi-threshold rule with singular nuisance information: the compilable reduction carries no margin)
exact_quantities.value_identity_group_between: 4 = (1/2)(-2)^2 + (1/2)(2)^2 (Phi(q) equals the K'=2 between-value of the projected law: one cell is wasted on a profiled-information-free nuisance split)

consequences: (M5) is load-bearing for the DS17(a) obstruction: dropping the separation margin, LCM laws do admit bounded-packet stationary configurations with full-rank binned information and macroscopic (M2)+(M3) margins

every such configuration is a wasted-cell structure: its projected centroids coincide pairwise and its reduced (mergeable) rule is a nuisance-degenerate strip rule, so the DS14 companion object compiled from it carries a singular nuisance block regardless

on N(0, I_2) the analogous family (any zero-mean measurable nuisance split of one threshold cell) is stationary with profiled value exactly v_2 = 2/pi and lambda_min up to 1/pi: the population constraint class {lambda_min(I_q) >= kappa} of DS16's v*(kappa) is nonempty for kappa <= 1/pi, while remaining compile-dead

verification.method: exact rational computation over the 8-atom symmetric quadrature law
verification.notes: Reproduced by py/ds_stable_basins.py selftest (signsplit_eight_atom_exact). Regression: tests/test_research_claims.py::test_ds17_signsplit_stationary_state_retains_margins_without_separation. The atomic law verifies the algebra exactly; the population statement lives on the atomless Gaussian counterpart (DS12 necessity is vacuous on finite atoms, as for CE-DS-POP-WASTED-CELLS-001).
